bda540195d25f5d4.title: 36th Annual Art Classic
bda540195d25f5d4.desc: SANTA CLARITA, CA — The Santa Clarita Artists Association (SCAA) is launching its most anticipated creative tradition under new leadership this season. Newly appointed SCAA President Pro Tem and Event Chair Tobi Beck—who also continues her long-standing three-year tenure as SCAA Gallery Chair—has announced the return of the 36th Annual Art Classic Fine Art Competition & Exhibit. This professionally judged exhibition will take place on Saturday, October 3 and Sunday, October 4, 2026 inside Cedar Hall at The Centre (20880 Centre Pointe Parkway). Serving as SCAA’s premier public fundraiser and showcase, the Art Classic is evolving under Beck's direction to celebrate contemporary creators with two newly defined media categories. The historic competition now features 10 distinct media divisions: Digital Art and Fluid Media, alongside traditional favorites like Oil, Acrylic, Watercolor, Dry Media, 2D Mixed Media & Collage, Photography, Sculpture & 3D Art, and an elite Masters Division. Call for Artists: All visual artists in the community aged 16 or older are highly encouraged to submit their original artwork. To enter, participants simply need to become active members of SCAA online.…
